subtitle: On the Yamuna Road, a Fortified City That Refused to Fade

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of the massive earthen ramparts rising above the Yamuna plain at dusk
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi stands atop a broad, packed-earth rampart overlooking the distant silver curve of the Yamuna and a caravan road, with carts and traders as tiny specks below.

dialogue.text: On the Yamuna road rose Kausambi, Vatsa’s proud capital, whose rampart builders and merchants turned a riverbank into a city that lived on for centuries after its kings were gone.

i18n.hi: यमुना मार्ग पर उठी कौसांबी, वत्स की शान, जहाँ कारीगरों व बनियों ने नदी किनारे को सदियों जीती रहने वाली नगरी बना दिया।

panels.shot: high bird’s-eye view following the Yamuna as it bends past the city mound and the ancient road
panels.action: From above, the broad Yamuna glides past a raised settlement mound cut by a straight road, with Rampart Builder of Kausambi seen as a small figure near a half-built wall.

dialogue.text: Here the Yamuna turns, and with it turns a road that once linked Vatsa to other mahajanapadas; at that bend Kausambi rose, long before Ashoka’s name was ever carved in stone.

i18n.hi: यहीं यमुना मुड़ती है, और साथ में मुड़ता है वो मार्ग जो वत्स को दूसरे महाजनपदों से जोड़ता था; उसी मोड़ पर उठी कौसांबी, अशोक का नाम पत्थर पर उभरने से बहुत पहले।

panels.shot: mid-shot at ground level of early workers shaping the rampart base with baskets and wooden tools
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi, younger and bare-backed, strains with others to tip baskets of earth onto a rising embankment, wooden rammers in the hands of workers tamping layers.

dialogue.text: Archaeologists like G.R. Sharma peeled back the earth and found older earth within it: packed layers of mud and brick, the bones of an early historic fort that guarded Vatsa’s seat.

i18n.hi: जी.आर. शर्मा जैसे पुरातत्त्वविदों ने धरती की परतें उघाड़ीं, और भीतर पुरानी धरती मिली: ठुंसी हुई मिट्टी‑ईंट की परतें, वत्स की राजधानी की रक्षा करते प्राचीन किले की हड्डियाँ।

panels.shot: close-up on hands pressing a brick into place in the rampart wall, with the city interior blurred beyond
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi’s rough hands press a large mud brick into a neatly aligned course atop the rampart, while beyond him faint outlines hint at timber halls and courtyards inside the city.

dialogue.text: No Vatsa king names this place in stone, yet the ramparts speak: a capital that needed walls, a frontier to the west, and neighbours whose armies made such labour necessary.

i18n.hi: कोई वत्स राजा इस जगह को शिलालेख में नहीं लिखता, पर प्राचीरें बोलती हैं: राजधानी जिसे दीवारें चाहिए थीं, पश्चिमी सीमा, और ऐसे पड़ोसी जिनकी सेनाएँ ये मेहनत करवाएँ।

panels.shot: wide interior city view with a road axis leading from a gate toward crowded streets and markets
panels.action: From the city gate atop the rampart, Rampart Builder of Kausambi looks down a straight street where ox-carts, traders, and artisans move between rows of brick and timber buildings.

dialogue.text: Inside the walls, streets aligned with the gates; carts rolled in from the countryside and out again, for Kausambi sat not only by a river but astride roads of salt, cloth and grain.

i18n.hi: दीवारों के भीतर सड़कों की दिशा फाटकों से मिलती; बैलगाड़ियाँ गाँवों से आती‑जाती रहीं, क्योंकि कौसांबी सिर्फ नदी किनारे नहीं, बल्कि नमक, कपड़े और अन्न की सड़कों पर जमी थी।

panels.shot: intimate courtyard mid-shot of wealthy merchants meeting a city official with ledgers and seals
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi, now in a simple but clean cloth, stands aside in a courtyard while richly dressed merchants confer with a seated official holding palm-leaf records and a sealing device.

dialogue.text: Pali texts remember Kausambi’s merchants by name: Ghosita and others who, with wealth drawn from this trade, sponsored parks and meeting places at the edge of the city.

i18n.hi: पाली ग्रंथ कौसांबी के बनियों को नाम से याद रखते हैं: घोषित और दूसरे, जिन्होंने इसी व्यापार से कमाई दौलत से नगर किनारे उद्यान और सभा‑स्थल बनवाए।

panels.shot: soft wide shot of a tree-shaded park outside the walls, with simple halls and resting travellers
panels.action: Under broad trees beyond the rampart, Rampart Builder of Kausambi walks past simple wooden pavilions where travellers rest, nearby a small hall with open pillars facing a quiet grove.

dialogue.text: The texts place the Buddha visiting such parks at Kosambi, yet the soil is silent: excavators found halls, courtyards and shrines, but none can be tied with certainty to Ghosita’s famed park.

i18n.hi: ग्रंथों में बुद्ध ऐसे ही उद्यानों में कोसंबी आए, पर मिट्टी चुप है: खुदाइयों में सभा‑महल, आँगन और मंदिर मिले, पर कोई भी निश्चित रूप से घोषित के विख्यात उद्यान से नहीं जुड़ता।

panels.shot: dramatic mid-shot of Rampart Builder listening in a small assembly hall where monks debate
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi watches from the doorway of a modest brick hall as robed monks face each other in tense silence, lay followers seated along the walls, the air heavy with expectation.

dialogue.text: Traditions remember Kausambi as a place of fierce quarrels — among monks, among courtiers — a city where religion, politics and trade crossed and sometimes collided within the same halls.

i18n.hi: परंपराएँ कौसांबी को घमासान झगड़ों की जगह मानती हैं — भिक्षुओं के, दरबारियों के — शहर जहाँ धर्म, राजनीति और व्यापार एक ही हॉल में टकरा जाते थे।

panels.shot: stylised split-scene showing a Jain teacher addressing King Udayana in a palace on one side, and a craftsman quarter on the other
panels.action: On one side, Rampart Builder of Kausambi stands in the shadows as a Jain teacher speaks to a crowned King Udayana in a pillared audience hall; on the other, he works among rows of kilns and potters’ wheels.

dialogue.text: Jain texts place King Udayana of Vatsa here, his palace an inferred shape in the mound; while clay and brick speak more clearly of potters, smiths and builders whose hands made the city function.

i18n.hi: जैन ग्रंथ वत्स के राजा उदयनों को यहीं बसाते हैं, जिनका महल टीले में बस अनुमानित आकृति है; जबकि मिट्टी‑ईंट ज़्यादा साफ़ से कुम्हारों, लोहारों और मिस्त्रियों की मेहनत दिखाती है।

panels.shot: archaeological time-slice view: cutaway of stratified layers showing NBPW levels and later constructions
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi appears transparent like a ghost within a cutaway of the mound, layers of earth, post-holes and brick walls stacked above each other, with a level of fine, dark Northern Black Polished Ware vessels highlighted.

dialogue.text: Sharma’s trenches bit deep and found Northern Black Polished Ware gleaming in early levels, then later bricks and floors above them: proof that Kausambi endured from mahajanapada days into following ages.

i18n.hi: शर्मा की खाइयों ने गहराई में उतरकर उत्तर की काली मृदभांड चमकती पाई, फिर ऊपर की परतों में बाद की ईंटें और फर्श: सबूत कि कौसांबी महाजनपद युग से आगे भी टिकी रही।

panels.shot: mid-shot of a Mauryan-era scene with an imperial officer arriving at the city gate amid changed architecture
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi, older now, stands by the gate as a dignified Mauryan officer in simple but distinct attire enters with an escort, newer stone-lined drains and tidier brickwork visible around.

dialogue.text: Then everything changed: Vatsa’s own line faded, but the city stayed. Under the Mauryas, Kausambi became an imperial node, its officials answering not to a local king but to Pataliputra.

i18n.hi: फिर सब बदल गया: वत्स की रेखा मिट गई, पर शहर नहीं। मौर्यों के अधीन कौसांबी साम्राज्य का केंद्र बनी, जहाँ अफसर अब स्थानीय राजा नहीं, पाटलिपुत्र को उत्तर देते थे।

panels.shot: low-angle close-up of the Ashokan pillar with its inscription band, villagers and officials gathered around
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi stands among townspeople before a smooth stone pillar rising from the earth, its inscribed band catching the sun as officials gesture and explain to the crowd.

dialogue.text: On this very ground, Ashoka’s Minor Pillar Edict was carved, the so‑called Schism Edict addressing Kausambi officials directly, warning them not to tolerate splits within the Sangha.

i18n.hi: इसी धरती पर अशोक का लघु स्तंभलेख खुदा, जिसे फूट‑फूट वाला लेख कहते हैं, जो सीधे कौसांबी के अधिकारियों को संबोधित कर, संघ में फूट न सहने की चेतावनी देता है।

panels.shot: tight close-up of Rampart Builder’s face reflecting in the polished stone of the pillar
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi’s weathered face is reflected faintly in the polished pillar surface as he looks up, his eyes tracing the groove of the letters he cannot read.

dialogue.speaker: Rampart Builder of Kausambi
dialogue.text: New kings, same walls… the road still passes us.

i18n.hi: नए राजा, वही दीवारें… सड़क अब भी हमारे पास से गुजरती है।

panels.shot: broad, timeless wide shot showing successive processions: Vatsa court, Mauryan officials, later traders along the same road
panels.action: Along the same road outside the rampart, a ghostly procession layers Vatsa chariots, Mauryan envoys and later caravans, while Rampart Builder of Kausambi stands at the edge, unchanged, watching time pass.

dialogue.text: From Vatsa’s assemblies to Mauryan edicts and later dynasties, the same Yamuna road carried news, armies and wares; the city’s name shifted in texts, but its routes remained.

i18n.hi: वत्स की सभाओं से लेकर मौर्य फरमानों और बाद की वंशों तक, यही यमुना मार्ग खबरें, सेनाएँ और माल ढोता रहा; ग्रंथों में शहर का नाम बदला, राहें वही रहीं।

panels.shot: modern bird’s-eye showing archaeologists at trenches on the mound, with faint overlays of the ancient city plan
panels.action: In the present, archaeologists in hats and shirts work in neat trenches on the mound, their trowels and grids overlaid faintly by transparent lines of ancient streets and ramparts, while a faint image of Rampart Builder of Kausambi watches from the rampart edge.

dialogue.text: Modern spades, survey lines and reports like Sharma’s turn the mound back into streets and gates; yet the gaps remain, where palaces are inferred and parks remembered only in script.

i18n.hi: आज की कुदालें, नाप‑रेखाएँ और शर्मा जैसी रिपोर्टें टीले को फिर सड़कों और फाटकों में बदलती हैं; फिर भी खाली जगहें हैं, जहाँ महल बस अनुमान हैं और उद्यान सिर्फ लेखों में।

panels.shot: concluding wide at sunset from atop the rampart, showing the Yamuna, the road, and the faint pillar in the distance
panels.action: Rampart Builder of Kausambi stands silhouetted on the ancient rampart at sunset, the Yamuna glowing in the distance, the old road a pale line, and the Ashokan pillar a small but distinct shape on the horizon.

dialogue.text: Kausambi shows how a city outlives its rulers: by binding river and road, merchants and monks, rampart builders and imperial scribes into one long, shifting story on the Yamuna’s bend.

i18n.hi: कौसांबी दिखाती है कि शहर अपने शासकों से लंबा जीता है: नदी और सड़क, व्यापारी और भिक्षु, प्राचीर गढ़ने वाले और साम्राज्य के लेखक — सबको यमुना मोड़ की एक लंबी, बदलती कहानी में बाँधकर।

subtitle_i18n.en: On the Yamuna Road, a Fortified City That Refused to Fade
subtitle_i18n.hi: यमुना मार्ग पर, मिटने से इनकार करती किलेबंद नगरी
